articles.summary: DOVER, Del. – At their meeting held today, the Board of Directors of Chesapeake Utilities Corporation (NYSE: CPK) declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.735 per share on the Company’s common stock. The $0.735 per share dividend will be paid on January 5, 2027, to all shareholders of record at the close of business [...] The post Chesapeake Utilities Corporation Announces Quarterly Dividend appeared first on Chesapeake Utilities Corporation .
articles.title: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation Announces Quarterly Dividend
